hotspots.title: Iran's revenge threats against Western leaders
hotspots.blurb: Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has issued threats of retaliation against Western leaders, including Italy's PM Giorgia Meloni, former U.S. President Donald Trump, and others, following the death of former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. Iranian state media published a 'hit list' with doctored images of these leaders in prison uniforms.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the high-stakes geopolitical tensions, direct threats to prominent leaders, and the potential for escalating conflict in the Middle East.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen, leader of France's far-right Rassemblement National (RN), has regained her eligibility to run for president after a court ruling reduced her ineligibility period. This follows her conviction for misuse of EU funds. Le Pen's candidacy for the 2027 presidential election is now a dominant theme in French political discourse.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the legal and political drama surrounding Le Pen's eligibility, the high stakes of the French presidential election, and the broader implications for far-right politics in Europe.

hotspots.title: AfD's Saxony-Anhalt 100-day plan
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) has unveiled a 100-day action plan for Saxony-Anhalt, aiming to implement radical policies if elected in the upcoming state elections. The plan includes stricter immigration controls, mandatory work for asylum seekers, and changes to education and media policies.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is highly charged due to the AfD's rising influence, the controversial nature of its policies, and the potential implications for Germany's political landscape and EU relations.

hotspots.blurb: U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham, a key ally of former President Donald Trump, has died suddenly at the age of 71. Graham's death has sparked widespread reactions, conspiracy theories, and tributes, dominating right-wing discourse in the U.S.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the sudden and unexpected nature of Graham's death, his prominent role in U.S. politics, and the conspiracy theories it has spawned within the MAGA movement.

hotspots.title: PiS opposes Ukraine's EU membership
hotspots.blurb: Poland's ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party has announced its opposition to Ukraine's EU membership, citing historical grievances related to the Volhynia massacres during World War II. This stance has escalated tensions between Poland and Ukraine and sparked internal political debates.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is highly charged due to the historical sensitivities involved, the geopolitical implications for EU-Ukraine relations, and the internal political divisions it has exposed in Poland.
